Default container scheduler (`scheduler-docker-local`). Runs app processes defined in `Procfile` as Docker containers on the local daemon, enforces resource limits, performs zero-downtime deploy checks, and manages persistent storage mounts.

Central PaaS engine (Go + Shell, v0.37.7). Provides the `dokku` CLI, the plugin trigger dispatcher, app lifecycle management (create / deploy / scale / destroy / run), environment config, and the admin HTTP API used by CI integrations and the Dokku Pro dashboard.
Bare git repository manager (Go plugin). Maintains one bare repo per app under `/var/lib/dokku/`. On `git push`, the post-receive hook fires and passes the source archive to the build pipeline.

Default HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy (`nginx-vhosts` plugin). Renders per-app nginx vhost configs on every deploy, routes `$APP.domain.tld` to the running container port, upgrades WebSocket connections, and terminates TLS. Caddy, Traefik, HAProxy, and OpenResty are plug-in alternatives.

Bash-based plugin trigger and lifecycle system. Installs community plugins from git URLs (`dokku plugin:install`), manages plugin updates, and dispatches named trigger hooks (50+ built-in triggers) to all registered plugins in priority order, enabling the full plugin ecosystem.

SSH server layer built on `sshcommand`. Authenticates incoming connections using stored public keys (`dokku ssh-keys:add`), then translates the git push command into a dokku deploy trigger — without granting shell access to the server.

Valkey 7 (Redis-compatible) used as both a cache layer and the Celery task broker for background workers and beat scheduler.
